concepts.name: 极简双掌
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original logo concept for the Chinese offline gesture strategy game "合掌".
Project context: friends clap twice then simultaneously reveal attack, defense or energy-forging hand gestures; mind games, timing, AI duels, team battles. The existing game's identity uses vermilion #d73e2d, ink black #171412, warm paper #f3eddf, restrained gold #d49b32. Its existing title is Chinese "合掌". This is a spirited social game.
Deliver a professional, sharply rendered flat vector-like LOGO, not a scene illustration, not a poster or product mockup. Single centered cohesive logo on a perfectly plain warm ivory background, square canvas, generous safe margin. High contrast, strong memorable silhouette, economical shapes, no unnecessary fine detail. The Chinese title must be clearly and correctly spelled "合掌" exactly once. No other text, no English, no watermark, no numbering, no explanation or presentation labels inside image. Original design. Avoid religious praying imagery, lotus flowers, Buddha, dragons, generic esports shields, weapons floating around the logo, realistic hand skin, extraneous props, gradients and 3D.
Design direction: contemporary iconic minimalism. A compact emblem above the title, composed of two boldly simplified stylized open palms meeting in a diagonal clap. One palm vermilion and the other ink black. Wrist origins are diagonally opposed, showing the kinetic moment of a clap; not symmetrical upright praying hands. Merge palms into a unified, almost square abstract silhouette with just enough finger notches to read as hands. A tiny ivory negative-space four-point impact spark at their meeting point conveys precise timing. Below the emblem, beautifully spaced custom Chinese geometric bold lettering "合掌" in ink black. Symbol about 55% of composition height, title 22%, carefully spaced. Modern, clean, confident and friendly; viable as a 32px app icon.

Design direction: expressive Chinese ink-brush identity, restrained and iconic. A minimal abstract clap symbol formed from two sweeping chunky calligraphic palm-like brush strokes that meet above the wordmark; the black and vermilion strokes suggest both opposing hands and the instant of a strategic move. A broad incomplete red brush arc softly unifies the mark, but no complete enclosing ring and no scenic background. Underneath, the very clear Chinese characters "合掌" are the hero, written in powerful original contemporary Chinese brush calligraphy with confident thick strokes and very limited dry-brush gaps. Preserve correct character structure. Energetic diagonals, beautifully controlled visual weight, spare composition, only ink black and vermilion. A logo recognizable from afar, not a painting.

Design direction: a modern Chinese vermilion seal. One distinctive large vermilion rounded-square seal containing the two Chinese characters "合掌" in warm ivory negative space. The two characters appear stacked vertically inside the seal, clear readable contemporary seal-inspired lettering with correct structure. The upper roof-like strokes of "合" subtly suggest two palms coming together; the lower "手" portion of "掌" has a beautiful clean hand-like logic. Strong generous inner spacing and bold square strokes, modest organic corner irregularities, no tiny distressed texture. The whole seal is one compact beautifully balanced app-icon-ready monogram. No duplicate title outside the seal, no additional glyphs, no other text. The red seal fills roughly 64% of the canvas, perfectly centered. Flat 2-color graphic, scholarly playfulness and timeless identity.

Design direction: playful energetic schoolyard game identity, chunky graphic sticker aesthetic with sophisticated restraint. Two highly simplified youthful cartoon open hands clap in the upper center at a slight offset angle, one warm ivory with ink-black outline, one vermilion with ink-black outline; keep anatomy legible, each hand has five digits suggested economically. Two bold impact ticks and one small sharp impact shape communicate the beat. Beneath, oversized compact Chinese "合掌" in rounded chunky custom display lettering with a subtle forward slant, ink black faces and a single flat vermilion offset edge. Hands and lettering form a single compact diamond-ish composition. Friendly fierce energy, like an excellent indie party-game logo, not a mascot face. Flat colors, bold contours, no gradients, no fine strokes, no comic panel or speech balloon.

Design direction: refined circular abstract strategy emblem. Two interlocking stylized palms, one vermilion and one ink black, rotate toward each other to form an elegant near-circular round emblem of attack and response. Finger grouping is reduced into just a few intentional broad stepped curves; each palm remains visually legible, no anatomical realism. Their meeting forms a small precise ivory angular spark-shaped negative space at the center. Balanced but dynamic, strong figure/ground relation. Do not draw a yin-yang symbol, dots, arrows, or a religious mandala; this is a unique palms-and-counterplay mark. Below the emblem place the Chinese wordmark "合掌" in a strong contemporary squared sans-serif with wide balanced strokes and carefully matched width. Large simple forms work at favicon size. Warm paper background, black-red flat graphic.

Design direction: a striking typography-first original Chinese game wordmark. The two characters "合掌" side by side in large, bold, sharply cut custom Chinese lettering form the entire hero logo. The roof strokes of "合" evoke two hands coming together, while the "手" component of "掌" is shaped with a subtle palm rhythm, but both Chinese characters must remain immediately correct and readable. Use thick ink-black angular strokes with only two judicious vermilion stroke accents, coordinated 12-degree forward tension and clever small ivory cuts implying clash and timing. Include exactly two short vermilion beat ticks above the gap between the characters to refer to the game's two claps. No separate emblem, no enclosing badge, no slogan. Beautiful typographic silhouette, substantial readable characters, premium contemporary Chinese indie-game title identity, minimal visual complexity.
